Anima seeds function differently than normal plants. Its growth cycle continues until eventually dying; while growing, however, players receive a benefit to their other farming patches depending on the seed used. After dying, players must plant another anima seed to continue receiving a benefit.
Once planted, cacti can be harvested for their appropriate crop. They possess a variable yield, however once fully picked, players can leave the plant to regenerate.
